scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.macos:dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,electron" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "sleep 2 && electron ."
scripts.swift:build: cd apps/macos && swift build && mkdir -p Curioforge.app/Contents/MacOS && cp .build/debug/Curioforge Curioforge.app/Contents/MacOS/Curioforge
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
